name: How do I choose a contractor for senior-friendly home remodeling?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose a contractor for senior-friendly home remodeling?

acceptedAnswer.text: When choosing a contractor for senior-friendly remodeling, look for experience in accessible design and aging-in-place modifications. Verify their licensing and insurance. Request references and review their portfolio to see examples of similar projects. Discuss their approach to communication, project management, and how they handle potential issues. A contractor familiar with specific safety standards and durable, easy-to-maintain materials will ensure a successful and appropriate renovation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a contractor with experience in accessible design, check licensing and insurance, review references, and discuss their communication and project management approach.
